Team —

We need a clean, consolidated pipeline rollup and one-paragraph account vignettes for the Exec QBR the week of 11/8. This thread is the coordination hub so we have a single source of truth. Please do the following by EOD Friday (10/30):

1) Pull a single-row snapshot for each open opportunity (owner, ARR, close month, confidence %). Add to the attached QBR_Pipeline_Template.xlsx (tab: "rollup").
2) For all named accounts, add a 2–3 sentence vignette (sales situation, top risk, mitigation, any exec asks) — use the tab "vignettes".
3) Flag any forecast deltas > 20% from last forecast and add a short rationale.

Priority accounts to finish first: Acme Platforms, Nimbus Health, Helix Security. If you own any of those, ping me directly and I'll block 30m for a quick sync.

Attachments: QBR_Pipeline_Template.xlsx (template for rollup + vignettes)

Thank you — I'll compile everything into the exec one-pager and share a draft on Monday.

—Karthik
